deployments_detail.use: AI drug discovery ("Elix Discovery" platform, FRONTEO Drug Discovery AI Factory, DataRobot); robots in HTS for 25+ years

Adopted Elix Discovery, an all-in-one AI drug discovery platform (multiple AI models trained via federated learning on data from 16 pharma companies), to accelerate design of novel small-molecule drug candidates, supporting both ligand-based (LBDD) and structure-based (SBDD) drug design. [Elix, Inc.]

YosAI, an in-house AI genotoxicity prediction system combining commercial in silico software, text mining, an Ames-test database, and machine learning, deployed across early discovery (screening thousands of compounds), development (impurities/intermediates) and formulation packaging hazard assessment. [SBX Corporation; MultiCASE Inc.]
deployments_detail.value: ~20% improvement in prediction accuracy for Eisai compounds vs. commercial in silico software

deployments_detail.use: AI-driven small molecule design using machine learning, deep learning and deep generative models to predict compound efficacy, chemical properties, pharmacokinetics and safety from structures and to propose novel compounds; used in several active drug discovery projects. [in-house]

World-first AI/machine learning model (with Oita University) using wristband wearable sensor data (activity, sleep, heart rate, conversation), lifestyle and background data to predict brain amyloid-beta positivity for early Alzheimer's screening. [Oita University]
deployments_detail.value: AUC 0.79 (all data combined); AUC 0.70 wristband data only; 122 participants

deployments_detail.use: Collaboration with Geisinger to evaluate a Passive Digital Marker (machine-learning algorithm) on de-identified EHR data for early detection and staging of cognitive impairment and dementia including Alzheimer's disease. [Geisinger (algorithm from Purdue University / Indiana University)]

Established Theoria Technologies subsidiary to build a digital dementia ecosystem, including risk-prediction algorithms for early detection of mild cognitive impairment/dementia (using clinical, cohort and PHR data) and the Sasaeru ADL-tracking app; algorithm service targeted for fiscal 2024. [in-house (Theoria Technologies Co., Ltd.)]

Easiit smartphone app, co-developed with DeNA, records footsteps, sleep, diet and nutrient data and provides brain-health/lifestyle self-management as part of Eisai's dementia ecosystem business. [DeNA Co., Ltd.]

Machine learning for drug formulation and manufacturing: models analyze reflected light from tablets/granules to non-destructively predict moisture content and active-ingredient concentration on continuous manufacturing lines, plus Bayesian optimization for formulation design. [in-house]

Eisai Korea partnership (MOU) with Neurophet to supply and operate Neurophet AQUA, AI-powered brain neurodegeneration imaging analysis software, for dementia screening/diagnosis across Korean medical institutions and screening centers. [Neurophet]
